data.one_liner: Passio Nutrition AI SDK for food recognition, nutrition data, and dietary assistant chat.
data.what_it_does: Provides real-time food recognition using the device camera, nutritional information lookup, barcode scanning, and a conversational nutrition advisor.
use_when: You are building a diet, fitness, or health app requiring food recognition.
You need to scan food barcodes and read nutrition facts labels.
You want to integrate a conversational nutrition AI advisor.
avoid_when: Your app does not require food and nutrition tracking.
You cannot obtain a valid Passio SDK key.
strengths: Real-time camera food recognition without storing photos by default.
Built-in nutrition advisor chat supporting text and image inputs.
Comprehensive nutrition information including ingredients and serving sizes.
weaknesses: Requires a paid subscription and a valid SDK key from Passio to function.
Platform support is limited to Android (SDK 26+) and iOS (13.0+).
data.setup_notes: Requires signing up at Passio AI for an SDK key, configuring minimum SDK versions (Android 26+, iOS 13.0+), and requesting camera permissions.
